> Check SDRF-Proteomics files against the specification's structural rules, one row per finding.

Wire verb `sdrf validate` · Python `pymzlib.sdrf.validate` (not yet shipped)

### Wraps

- [`SdrfValidator.Validate`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/23c2490e/mzLib/Readers/Sdrf/SdrfValidator.cs) in `mzLib/Readers/Sdrf/SdrfValidator.cs` at mzLib `23c2490e`
- [`SdrfValidationResult`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/23c2490e/mzLib/Readers/Sdrf/SdrfValidation.cs) in `mzLib/Readers/Sdrf/SdrfValidation.cs` at mzLib `23c2490e`

### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Unit | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | `path` | absent | — | — | One .sdrf.tsv file. Exactly one of path and paths-stdin is required. |
| `paths_stdin` (wire `--paths-stdin`) | `flag` | absent | — | — | Read many paths from stdin, one per line (BULK.md section 1). Blank lines are ignored; a repeated path is a usage error. Switches the result to the bulk shape below. |
| `threads` | `int` | `1` | documents | `>= 1, or -1` | Documents validated at once; -1 is every core. The output is byte-identical at any value (tested at 1, 4 and -1). |
| `on_error` (wire `--on-error`) | `string` | `fail` | — | `fail \| skip` | fail: the first failure IN INPUT ORDER aborts the call. skip: recorded in files[i].error and the batch carries on. skip with path is a usage error. |

### Returns

Top-level fields:

| Field | Type | Unit | Null? | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | `string` | — | never | The absolute path validated. |
| `is_valid` | `bool` | — | never | No Error findings. Warnings never make a document invalid. |
| `error_count` | `int` | findings | never | Findings of severity Error. |
| `warning_count` | `int` | findings | never | Findings of severity Warning. |
| `message_count` | `int` | findings | never | All findings; the length of every column. |
| `row_count` | `int` | rows | never | Data rows in the document. |
| `column_names` | `string[]` | — | never | The table's columns in order. |
| `columns` | `table` | — | never | Column name to one value per finding, in mzLib's order. |
| `caveats` | `string[]` | — | never | Four static caveats. |

Per-row fields (one value per record, in `columns` or each list entry):

| Field | Type | Unit | Null? | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `source_index` | `int` | — | never | 0-based position of the document in the stdin list. *Present only with `--paths-stdin`.* |
| `source_path` | `string` | — | never | Absolute path of the document. *Present only with `--paths-stdin`.* |
| `severity` | `string` | — | never | Error (cannot be reliably consumed) or Warning (deviates, still joinable). mzLib's SdrfValidationSeverity member name. |
| `rule` | `string` | — | never | Stable rule id: EmptyHeader, RequiredColumn, RecommendedColumn, EmptyColumnName, ColumnNameCase, MalformedColumnName, ColumnOrdering, NoRows, RowWidth, EmptyCell, ReservedWordCase, NonIntegerValue, RowKeyUniqueness (at 23c2490e). |
| `message` | `string` | — | never | Human-readable, including the offending value. |
| `row_index` | `int` | — | yes: the finding is about the whole document (a missing column, an empty header, no rows), not one row | 0-based index into the data rows. |
| `line_number` | `int` | — | yes: same as row_index: a document-level finding | 1-based line in the file: row_index + 2, because the header is line 1. |
| `column_name` | `string` | — | yes: the finding is not about one column (RowWidth, RowKeyUniqueness, NoRows, EmptyHeader) | The column involved; for a ragged row's extra cells, "(column N)". |

### Errors

| Kind | pyMzLib raises | When |
|---|---|---|
| `usage` | [`UsageError`][pymzlib.UsageError] | neither or both of path and paths-stdin; stdin empty under paths-stdin; a repeated path |
| `usage` | [`UsageError`][pymzlib.UsageError] | a file not found (under fail, checked before any document is read) |
| `usage` | [`UsageError`][pymzlib.UsageError] | threads 0 or below -1 or not an integer; on-error not fail or skip, or given without a value; on-error skip with path |
| `correctness` | [`BridgeError`][pymzlib.BridgeError] | mzLib cannot read a document (MzLibException for an empty file); under fail, the lowest input position's failure is raised |
| `service_unavailable` | [`ServiceUnavailableError`][pymzlib.ServiceUnavailableError] | never raised by this verb |

### Caveats

- STRUCTURE ONLY: column presence, order, casing, cell shape and row-key uniqueness against v1.1.0. Controlled-vocabulary accessions are not resolved.
- Severities were calibrated by mzLib against the 1,236-file bigbio curated corpus; a rule that fired on most curated files was demoted, not the files condemned.
- A document of reserved words validates cleanly. Use sdrf assess for whether it says anything, sdrf lint for whether several agree.

### Example

```python
result = pymzlib.sdrf.validate('sdrf_cohort.sdrf.tsv')
```

Recorded from the live bridge as [`sdrf_validate_cohort.json`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/pyMzLib/blob/main/pkg/python/tests/fixtures/sdrf_validate_cohort.json). The doctests in the API reference replay these recordings in CI.

```python
result = pymzlib.sdrf.validate('sdrf_skeleton.sdrf.tsv')
```

Recorded from the live bridge as [`sdrf_validate_skeleton.json`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/pyMzLib/blob/main/pkg/python/tests/fixtures/sdrf_validate_skeleton.json). The doctests in the API reference replay these recordings in CI.

```python
batch = pymzlib.sdrf.validate_many(['sdrf_skeleton.sdrf.tsv', 'sdrf_cohort.sdrf.tsv', 'missing.sdrf.tsv'], on_error='skip')
```

Recorded from the live bridge as [`sdrf_validate_bulk.json`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/pyMzLib/blob/main/pkg/python/tests/fixtures/sdrf_validate_bulk.json). The doctests in the API reference replay these recordings in CI.
